end.parentNote: Asha practised equal shares, halves, thirds, quarters, and fractions of collections. Nisha used the total number of equal parts to identify thirds and correctly found one-third of 9 as 3 drumsticks. They mixed up the denominator with the number eaten or shaded in some examples; this was corrected later when they identified 2/5 and answered 3 drumsticks. At home, share small groups of objects equally and ask, “What is one-third or one-half?”
